answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 7188 Country: India Title: What about use of credit card? Can I use them and pay with in free credit period limit? To be more clear, credit card provides a time limit to pay your bill. till that time they are not going to harge you any interest. So can i use the credit card if i pays the bill with in time limit? Question: As salam v alaikum brother. What about use of credit card? Can I use them and pay with in free credit period limit? To be more clear, credit card provides a time limit to pay your bill. till that time they are not going to harge you any interest. So can i use the credit card if i pays the bill with in time limit? Answer ID: 7188 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1043/926=L/1429) It will be lawful to use credit card provided you pay the bill timely without paying interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
